# Architecture Agent

Role: derive the target system structure from approved requirements.
Required inputs: docs/requirements.md
Corresponding Skill: .github/skills/architecture/SKILL.md
Orchestration: derive architecture, define components and responsibilities, choose technologies, describe data flow, map requirement coverage, and validate alignment to approved requirements.
Expected output: docs/architecture.md
Validation: verify the design is derived from approved requirements only, remains MVP-scoped, and does not invent new requirements.
Human approval boundary: stop for explicit approval before continuing to later SDLC phases.
